newsitem.title: USA: NeXstar to start phase II MiKasome trial.
newsitem.headline: NeXstar to start phase II MiKasome trial.

text.p: NeXstar Pharmaceuticals Inc plans to start phase II clinical trials on MiKasome, an antibiotic, later this year.
NeXstar will start phase II trials in multiple indications, including hospital-acquired pneumonia, urinary tract infections, infectious exacerbations in cystic fibrosis, and bacterial endocarditis.
The company expects MiKasome to become a very important drug based on its preclinical data and the initial phase I results.
NeXstar is a pharmaceutical company engaged in the discovery, development, manufacturing and marketing of products to treat life-threatening diseases.
